name: Sunscorched Shells
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
My colleague, Furen Longbeard, made a discovery which I am eager to test.  I wish to try it on a new armor that I am researching, for I believe Furen's techniques will produce superior results.

Will you help me?  If you gather what I need to make the armor, then I will make an extra piece for you.

I need the sunscorched egg shells of the Highperch Wyverns who dwell at Highperch, in Thousand Needles.  Search for the shells below their nests, and return to me when you have a sufficient amount.
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 Sunscorched Shells to Mathiel in Darnassus.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, thank you. These will work splendidly!

I will begin fashioning the armor immediately...
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have the shells, adventurer? They are quite strong, and can be rendered into a lacquer I will use to coat the links of my new mail armor.

quests.objectiveText: Enter the Rethban Caverns, reach the first fork, and return to Yorus Barleybrew within the time allowed. You must not die and release your spirit.

quests.name: The Shieldsmith
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Cask of Scalder to Furen Longbeard.

quests.name: Fire Hardened Mail
quests.objectiveText: Gather the materials Furen Longbeard requires, and bring them to him in Stormwind.

quests.name: Sunscorched Shells
quests.objectiveText: Bring 20 Sunscorched Shells to Mathiel in Darnassus.
